explanations.A: The positional input selects one exact NuGet package ID. The library-literal equality operand is decoded UTF-16 text; https:// is preserved verbatim and matched as an ordinal substring of each decoded string-literal use in implementation libraries selected for the exact --tfm net8.0 target. The library-literal predicate and --tfm require each other. This downloads package content and requires a package-content provider. Identical repeated literal operands collapse; distinct operands are incompatible. The operand length is 1..1024 UTF-16 code units, so 600 astral Unicode characters take 1200 units and are rejected. The empty listed values are not an allow list; acceptance comes from the explicit input rules, not the empty list.
explanations.B: An exact depends=Newtonsoft.Json predicate with dependency-depth=3 uses the preferred reachability spelling: it can match direct declaration edges at depth 1 or transitive declaration paths at depth 2 or 3. The legacy depends-transitive=Newtonsoft.Json spelling would match only depths 2 through 3 and would exclude a direct-only hit. dependency-depth accepts exactly 2, 3, or 4 as the selected maximum, so depth 1 is invalid; dependency-target=all is invalid with traversal. An explicit dependency-target=net8.0 is required, and the depth facet requires an exact depends predicate or legacy depends-transitive predicate. Repeated exact predicates AND and share traversal. This uses nuspec/dependency metadata; command preparation does not establish an actual dependency match.
explanations.candidate_vs_rows: For a Microsoft.Azure.* population with either inspection predicate, put 'Microsoft.Azure.*' in the positional slot, add --take 5 to bound package candidates examined (the maximum admitted for these predicates), and add -n 2 to request at most two final result rows. -n 2 does not bound candidate inspection work; --take does. A five-candidate bound also limits the completeness of conclusions about the full prefix population.
